hooks.command: jq -e '.last_assistant_message | test("^喵～")' && exit 0 || (echo 'Response must start with 喵～' >&2 && exit 2)
jq -e '.last_assistant_message | test("\\b你\\b") | not' && exit 0 || (echo 'Response must not use 你 to address the user. Use 开发者大大 instead.' >&2 && exit 2)
jq -e '.last_assistant_message | test("[a-zA-Z]") | not' && exit 0 || (echo 'Response must use only Chinese characters, not English letters.' >&2 && exit 2)
jq -e '.last_assistant_message | test("哒～$")' && exit 0 || (echo 'Response must end with 哒～' >&2 && exit 2)

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(py|sh|rb|js|ts|go|rs|java|c|cpp|h|m|swift|kt|scala|groovy|clojure|pl|php|r|lua|vim|sql|yaml|yml|json|toml|xml|html|css|scss|less|vue|jsx|tsx|bash)$ ]]; then head -1 "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q '.*-\*-.*coding.*utf-8.*-\*-' || (echo "First line must contain: # -*- coding: utf-8 -*-" >&2 && exit 2); fi; }; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(py|sh|rb|js|ts|go|rs|java|c|cpp|h|m|swift|kt|scala|groovy|clojure|pl|php|r|lua|vim|sql|yaml|yml|json|toml|xml|html|css|scss|less|vue|jsx|tsx|bash)$ ]]; then sed -n '2p' "$f" 2>/dev/null | grep -q 'AI-Assisted.*Initial draft generated by Claude Code.*reviewed and modified by author' || (echo "Second line must contain the AI-Assisted comment: # AI-Assisted: Initial draft generated by Claude Code; reviewed and modified by author." >&2 && exit 2); fi; }; exit 0

jq -r '.tool_input.file_path' | { read -r f; if [[ "$f" =~ \.(py|js|ts|jsx|tsx)$ ]]; then python3 /opt/enforce/check_function_size.py "$f" 2>&1 | grep -q 'violations' && exit 2 || exit 0; fi; exit 0; }
